description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes flow control API objects, including flow schemas, priority level configurations, and related rules and conditions.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchema
methods.description: Validates the content of a FlowSchema object, including metadata, spec, and status.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to a FlowSchema object.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaSpec
methods.description: Validates the spec field of a FlowSchema, including matching precedence, distinguisher method, priority level reference, and rules.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaPolicyRulesWithSubjects
methods.description: Validates policy rules with subjects in a FlowSchema.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaSubject
methods.description: Validates a subject in a FlowSchema, including service account, user, and group kinds.

methods.name: ValidateServiceAccountSubject
methods.description: Validates a ServiceAccountSubject object.

methods.name: ValidateUserSubject
methods.description: Validates a UserSubject object.

methods.name: ValidateGroupSubject
methods.description: Validates a GroupSubject object.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaNonResourcePolicyRule
methods.description: Validates a non-resource policy rule in a FlowSchema.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaResourcePolicyRule
methods.description: Validates a resource policy rule in a FlowSchema.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaStatus
methods.description: Validates the status conditions of a FlowSchema.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaStatusUpdate
methods.description: Validates status update for a FlowSchema.

methods.name: ValidateFlowSchemaCondition
methods.description: Validates a condition in the FlowSchema status.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelConfiguration
methods.description: Validates a PriorityLevelConfiguration object, including metadata, spec, and status.

methods.name: ValidateIfMandatoryPriorityLevelConfigurationObject
methods.description: Ensures the priority level configuration matches mandatory fixed values.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelConfigurationSpec
methods.description: Validates the spec of a PriorityLevelConfiguration, including type, limited/exempt settings, and limit response.

methods.name: ValidateLimitedPriorityLevelConfiguration
methods.description: Validates a LimitedPriorityLevelConfiguration object.

methods.name: ValidateExemptPriorityLevelConfiguration
methods.description: Validates an ExemptPriorityLevelConfiguration object.

methods.name: ValidateLimitResponse
methods.description: Validates a LimitResponse object.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelQueuingConfiguration
methods.description: Validates a QueuingConfiguration for a priority level.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelConfigurationStatus
methods.description: Validates the status of a PriorityLevelConfiguration.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelConfigurationStatusUpdate
methods.description: Validates status update for PriorityLevelConfiguration.

methods.name: ValidatePriorityLevelConfigurationCondition
methods.description: Validates a condition in PriorityLevelConfiguration status.

methods.name: ValidateNonResourceURLPath
methods.description: Validates a non-resource URL path according to specific rules.
